entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All right, all clean! I bet the chief is[n]gonna be happy with this.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Thinking about the customers and[n]cleaning the store probably helped to[n]increase your [stIcon 4][clr 26][stLabel 4][clr 27], no?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That took longer than I expected.[n]We should go to bed once we clean[n]up the rest.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I would help you out, if I wasn't like this.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hmm, it's important to clean here,[n]but what about upstairs?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, I mean you call it... retro? Antique?[n]Point is, it's good in its own way.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hmm, it's pretty dirty here...[n]Maybe this place is surprisingly popular.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I guess you won't get paid for this...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It sure feels good to clean up.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Don't get mad if I make it a little bit[n]dirty when I get off the chair, okay?
